Privacy Policy

This is an English translation for convenience. If it differs from the Korean original, the Korean version (한국어 원문) prevails.

Effective date: October 16, 2026

Acard (the "Service") processes only the minimum information necessary to create and maintain an account.

1. Information We Process

Email address, password (stored only in encrypted form), the name, email, and profile picture provided by Google when you sign in with Google, sign-in records, and content you create yourself while using the Service.

1-1. Beta Waitlist and Feedback

The email address and optional information you provide when joining the beta waitlist (the AI tools you use, what you want to use the Service for, your Discord ID, and how you heard about us) are used only to manage your place in line and to send you an invitation. For feedback sent from the app, we store its content and your account email, and also post it to a private Discord channel viewed by the operations team. To verify beta operations, we record usage events such as signing up, opening your first page, and redeeming an invite code only once per account, without using external analytics tools. If you request deletion of your waitlist information at hello@notes.example.com, we will delete it within 7 days.

2. Purpose of Use

Member identification and sign-in, account security, and communications necessary for operating the Service, such as password resets. We do not use your information for advertising or sell it to third parties.

3. Retention and Outsourcing

Account information is stored with Supabase (authentication and database) and Cloudflare (hosting). When you delete your account, your account information is deleted without delay.

4. Your Rights

You may delete your account at any time from the account screen, and you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your information.

5. Contact

hello@notes.example.com

Privacy Policy

Acard ("the Service") processes only the minimum information needed to create and keep your account.

1. Information we process

Email address, password (stored only in hashed form), the name, email and profile picture Google provides when you sign in with Google, sign-in records, and content you create in the Service.

The email and optional answers (AI tool, intended use, Discord handle, referral source) you give when joining the beta waitlist are used only to manage your place and send your invite. Account data is stored with Supabase (authentication and database) and Cloudflare (hosting). When you delete your account, your account data is deleted without delay.
